name: Silverbeck Pensions

ring.prompt: Welcome to Silverbeck Pensions. For quality purposes your call may be recorded. Please listen to the following options.

menu.prompt: For annual statements, press one. To report the death of a member, press two. For transfers, press three. For all other enquiries, press four.
menu.wrongKeyPrompt: That key wasn't recognised. Please choose from the options again.

holdAnnouncement: Thank you for waiting. A member of our pensions team will be with you shortly.

clerk.greeting: Bereavement line, Eileen speaking — please accept my condolences. Could I take the member's full name?

turns.reprompt: Sorry, could you say the member's name again for me, nice and slowly?

turns.say: Thank you. And the date of death, as it will appear on the certificate?
turns.reprompt: Could I have that date once more, please?

outcome.closing: I've marked the member's record and stopped any payments going out, so nothing needs paying back later. Your reference is {REF}. Our bereavement pack will be with the executor within five working days.

quirk: Stops pension payments on the spot so the estate never has to return an overpayment.
